patterns.note: Content is presented in a single, narrow, centered column with generous horizontal and vertical whitespace, creating a highly focused reading experience.
A stark monochromatic palette of white and black is used for backgrounds and primary text, with a single bright blue for interactive elements like links.
A simple, fixed header containing the logo and search bar remains at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing persistent navigation.
Information is structured in a clear FAQ-like format, using bold headings for questions and standard body text for answers, enhancing scannability for specific information.

technique_notes: The primary content area is constrained by a maximum width and centered horizontally, ensuring readability on various screen sizes while maintaining a clean, focused layout.
A minimalist color scheme relies on high contrast between black text and a white background, with a single accent color used sparingly for interactive elements like links.
The site's motion system is limited to a sticky header, which is achieved by fixing its position to the top of the viewport so it remains visible while the page content scrolls beneath it.

design_tokens.type_scale: Clear, hierarchical sans-serif headings (~1.5-2x body) with standard weight body text, all in a consistent, readable sans-serif family.
design_tokens.radius: subtle — minimal rounding on input fields and buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — ample line height and vertical spacing between content blocks, with generous horizontal padding for the main content column.

standout: The design's standout feature is its extreme, almost invisible, minimalism. It strips away all non-essential visual elements to create a pure content-first experience, making the information itself the sole focus without any decorative distractions. It feels less like a marketing site and more like a highly functional, clean document.
